grounding.states: Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina

value.answer: Messi, for me. He's been the best player of his generation for nearly two decades, and he finally won the World Cup in 2022, which is what ends most arguments. Pelé and Maradona are the names people always bring up against him, and they're fair picks too, but Messi is the one I'd take.
